adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review recovered table-backed activity and toxicity evidence, reconciled database rows with source locators and preserved schema/database-only cautions, and converted framework-test output into source-reviewed caution-bearing final adjudication.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Some linked DBAASP synergy rows store FICi values while the database measure-group field says MIC; final activity rows preserve MIC/MSC/FICi as separate source columns.
CAMP/dbAMP text rows remain database_only_no_primary_source when the local packet lacks a peptide identity key sufficient for source verification.
NPN assay is retained as direct mechanism evidence but exact figure values are not invented from chart images.

per_layer_decision_rationale.mechanism: Mechanism claims are bounded to LPS competition and NPN direct assays plus alanine-scan context; exact NPN figure values are not fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker-2: Rebuilt 626 source-supported rows from NXML Tables 1-6 and supplementary PDF text Tables S1-S15 with target species/strain, units, endpoint labels, and locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker-4: Reconciled linked database rows against peptide/table locators; DBAASP rows with recoverable peptide keys are source-located, while non-DBAASP rows without recoverable sequence keys remain database_only_no_primary_source with caution context.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker-6: Closed the prior ticket only after owned activity/database/review artifacts were rewritten from local sources and strict gates were rerun; final acceptance remains caution-bearing, not clean.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Mechanism evidence is bounded to qualitative/direct-assay support and does not invent exact figure values.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Local text/captions support the NPN assay and qualitative/figure-level interpretation, but no machine-readable numeric NPN uptake table is present in the packet.
